objective: Make a claude.ai cloud session whose main thread is not the holyagent agent become the root: inject the core root rules and the absolute CLI path at session start even in a project with no state folder, and offer a user-invocable skill that loads the root rules.
requirements: hook session-start: when the main thread is not holyagent, inject the core root rules even with no .holyagent, .holyclaude or .holycodex folder; stay silent only when the main thread already is holyagent.
Make the CLI resolvable: the injected context names the absolute script path, since CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is not set in the main thread's Bash.

No root skill (user decision): the root rules are the main-thread agent's instructions only, through the plugin agent setting and the session-start hook; remove the holyagent:root skill and its doc and test changes.
If the plugin agent setting is ignored for synced/available plugins, document the required install state or report it as a platform issue with evidence; do not work around it silently.
Add a test for hook session-start: no state folder + main thread not holyagent gives rules and CLI path; main thread holyagent gives nothing extra.
Do not modify the reference session. Do not add unrequested features.
Done means mise run verify passes; rebuild the plugin with mise run build when plugin sources change.
